reusable_learning.detail: A watcher left on a retired workspace copy, several hand-kept role lists, a registered tool that differs from the running one, and a wake box with no retention. Replacing a deliverer: list every live wake path first (boxes outside the workspace, per-role DM rooms, scripts a role depends on); one failing file must not hold a queue or keep the heartbeat green; a lock must name a verifiable owner.
